name: Witchcraft and Jelly: a Sticky Affair
source:
Ursa is a lonely witch severely lacking in confidence who more than anything wants a girlfriend and she's willing to go to drastic measures. In this visual novel, you will see her go through many struggles in this pursuit. 

[From [url=https://fava-beans.itch.io/witchcraft-and-jelly-a-sticky-affair]itch.io[/url]]
